findings.line: acceptance criterion 2 (file line 9486), the words 'или SEP, если правка нужна, потому что критерий 4 запрещает текст, общий для двух файлов'
findings.what: The criterion does not say how step 9 sees that a SEP row is really forced: nothing says that the 'was' text of such a row stands in both tenants of the sample. A SEP row could be used for any wanted rewrite, because the reason is a free label. The meaning is still readable and checkable by hand (compare 'was' with the other tenant in the sample), the six-row limit still caps the damage.
findings.fix: Optional, for the author or the design: name in the criterion or in the test design the check that a SEP row's 'was' text equals a text of the other tenant at the mapped path in the sample. Not required for PASS.
